pictures.name: QV1-Dawn-Market
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A village marketplace at dawn, mist and pale gold light. a landowner in his sixties with a white beard, a deep green robe and a kind, steady face, stands among a group of laborers with tools on their shoulders, holding up a single silver coin as he makes a deal; the men nod and head toward green vineyard hills behind. Hope for a day’s work.
